profile.headline: Software Engineer | Medical Imaging | Machine Learning
profile.summary:
o Over ten years of experience in  C/C++ software development on Linux/Windows.
o Strong background in GPU programming with over ten years of image reconstruction and simulation software development experience.
o Numerous publications and patents in medical imaging 
o 2014 University of Tennessee Chancellor’s Honor, Extra Professional Promise Award recipient
o 2011 ~ 2015 Ron-nutt (founder of CTI) Medical Imaging Fellowship recipient

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.locationName: San Mateo County, California, United States

positions.title: R&D Software Consultant
positions.description:
- Image post processing using VTK/ITK/C++
- Transmission and reflection ultrasound image reconstruction

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Optimized the performance of simulation code in Python. 
- Participated in a project to port the software package from Windows to NixOS(Linux).

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
(1) Designed and implemented breast density calculation software for quantitative ultrasound transmission imaging modality using unsupervised machine learning algorithm (Fuzzy C-Means). 
(2) Participated in the optimization of ultrasound transmission (Inverse scattering) and reflection (ray tracing) image reconstruction algorithm.
(3) Implemented functionalities on the QT scanner to allow the technician to view and analyze the DICOM images reprocess it using different processing scheme.
(4) Designed and implemented segmentation and image processing features in DICOM medical image viewer using VTK/ITK/QT/C++/CMAKE.
(5) Implemented live b-mode ultrasound scout scan prototype
(6) Successfully ported all the C/C++ software and device drivers from Ubuntu14.04 to Ubuntu18.04
(7) Participated in a project to build a framework to process a batch of image reconstruction tasks in AWS cloud.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
(1) Re-designed and implemented the reflection (ray-tracing) image reconstruction software using C/C++/CUDA/pthread on Linux. Optimized code runs 6 times faster with consistent output.
(2) Improved data acquisition and motion control software for ultrasound medical imaging device using Galil motion controllers and Linux device drivers. 
(3) Implemented a web-based performance visualization and device control framework using JavaScript/Node.js/C++

positions.title: Graduate Research Assistant
positions.description:
⋄ Co-invented novel motion correction techniques using particle tracking
⋄ Successfully designed and implemented a head and neck motion correction program for clinical PET technique in C/C++ and boost library.
⋄ Optimized an existing phase-based gating program by reducing its execution time (50 times speed up) by re-writing the code in C/C++ and boost library and eliminating redundant memory usage.

positions.title: Graduate Research Assistant
positions.description:
- Developed a web-based super performance analysis and visualization package for TITAN(world's second fastest super computer) of Oak Ridge National Laboratory and TACHYON2 of Korea Institute of Science and Information Technology using HTML5, JavaScript, and MongoDB.
- Designed and implemented a path-based profiling and recommendation using JavaScript, Python, and Neo4J graph database

positions.title: System Software Engineer
positions.description: Participated in the design and implementation of a real-time embedded data sharing middleware for Korean navy submarine combat system using C++, STL and boost library on Linux and VxWorks operating systems.

positions.title: Information Management Officer (IMO)
positions.description:
o	Led an information management team to maintain part of U.S. Army NIPERNET.
o	Acted as a non-commissioned officer in charge of a unit consisting of 50 soldiers
o	Awarded an Army Commendation Medal (ARCOM) for service in U.S. army

patents.title: MOTION CORRECTION FOR MEDICAL IMAGING
patents.issuer: US United States Patent Number 10,255,684 · Issued Apr 9, 2019
patents.description: Systems and methods for correcting motion during medical imaging involve using a detector to track annihilation photons produced by one of (i) external emitting sources placed onto a body of a person being imaged or (ii) an object of interest in the body. Motion information is generated based on the tracking. A motion-corrected image is formed from recorded image data, using the motion information.

patents.title: Clutter removal and improved methods of image reconstruction in quantitative transmission ultrasound tomography
